subject: Re: Private deployment demo — confirm UTC offset and pre-demo evidence
messages:
From: Emma Carter <emma@cardio.ai>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment trial — booking a demo

Hi Michael,

We just signed up for the Private trial (HealthMetrics). We're evaluating a VPC/on-prem pattern and would like an operational walkthrough focused on tenant isolation, network NATs, and encryption in transit. Our security lead will want to see a network diagram and SOC2 snapshot before the call.

Preferred window: PDT mornings (UTC-7) next week, ideally 60 minutes so we can include our infra and security folks.

I've attached our initial network sketch (network_diagram_v1.pdf). Can you share what evidence you can provide in advance? Also, quick confirm — our stakeholders are in PDT (US West) and CET (one engineer in Germany).

Thanks,
Emma Carter
Senior Cloud Architect
Cardio.AI
Attachment: network_diagram_v1.pdf (diagram, 220KB)

From: michael_grant@redwood.ai
To: Emma Carter <emma@cardio.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment trial — booking a demo

Hi Emma — great to hear from you, and welcome!

Thanks for the network sketch. We can definitely walk through tenant isolation, NATs, and the deployment topology during a 60-minute session. We typically provide a 1-page SOC 2 summary and a short pre-demo checklist; attaching those helps unblock security reviewers.

Two quick asks so we can lock a slot:
- Can you confirm the exact UTC offsets for each attendee (PDT/UTC-7 and CET/UTC+2) so we don't lose anyone to daylight-savings differences?
- Are there any elements in the network sketch (IP ranges, private peering) that require redaction before we display it in a shared meeting?

Available slots (PDT):
- Wed 2027-05-12, 09:00-10:00
- Wed 2027-05-12, 10:30-11:30
- Thu 2027-05-13, 09:00-10:00

If any of those work, I'll send a calendar invite and loop Aditya for the ops deep-dive. I've attached the SOC2 summary and the internal pre-demo checklist for your security team.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0172
Attachment: soc2-summary-2026.pdf (summary, 45KB); pre-demo-checklist.xlsx (template, 12KB)

From: Lucas Braun <l.braun@healthmetrics.com>

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment trial — booking a demo

Michael / Emma — looping in from HealthMetrics infra. Quick notes:
- Our CET engineer (Marta) is UTC+2 but is remote that week; she prefers 17:00 CET or earlier. That maps to 08:00 PDT which is tight for the Cardio.AI team.
- We do require SOC2 evidence and a short list of observable artifacts (audit logs, key rotation cadence). If you can include the SOC2 summary and a pointer to audit-log export options in the pre-read, that'd help speed procurement.

One last thing: we have an overlap with another vendor review on Thu 2027-05-13 at 09:00 PDT. If you can do Thu 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CET that would be perfect for us.

Thanks,
Lucas Braun
Senior Infrastructure Manager
HealthMetrics

Quick ping from SDR side — I can host the 08:00 PDT slot on Thu (Thu 2027-05-13 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CET) if that works. Aditya, would you be available as the ops lead for the deep-dive? If not, we should pick an alternate ops owner.

Emma — if you can confirm attendee list + any IPs we should avoid calling out (for redaction), I'll lock and circulate the invite.

Hi all,

Confirmed for Thu, 13 May 2027 — 08:00-09:00 PDT (17:00-18:00 CET). Calendar invite sent (see link in related_links).

Attached: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx and soc2-summary-2026.pdf. I also attached a redacted version of the network diagram Emma shared (network_diagram_v1_redacted.pdf) that we'll use in the call.

Pre-demo asks for your security team:

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Regards,
